title: Second Sino-Japanese War Begins
description: The Second Sino-Japanese War began on July 7, 1937, with the Marco Polo Bridge Incident near Beijing. This full-scale war between China and Japan lasted until 1945 and became merged into World War II. The conflict resulted in massive casualties - estimates range from 15-20 million Chinese deaths - and widespread atrocities including the Nanjing Massacre. The war devastated China's infrastructure and economy but ultimately strengthened nationalism and contributed to the eventual Communist victory in the Chinese Civil War.
